title: Error from WriteFile checked in the wrong scope

pr_metadata.title: Wrap dump errors
pr_metadata.body: Use errors.Join for future multi-writer support.

labels.defect: Shadowed err: the outer error from WriteFile is discarded and Join wraps the (nil) inner one
labels.evidence: Reproducible: make the target dir read-only — WriteFile fails, but Dump returns nil because the if-statement shadows err with Join(nil) which is nil; exports silently vanish.
